readerCopy.body: A fantasy that keeps returning can be carrying a much simpler need than the fantasy itself suggests. When Neptune conjoins Lilith, imagination and refusal fuse, making a difficult desire show up through daydreaming, fixation, art, longing, attraction, or the wish for a completely different life. The entire fantasy does not have to become literal for the message to matter. Privacy, affection, creative time, freedom, or different work may be the ordinary need hiding inside the dramatic version.
